title: Why You Shouldn't Use Sanitary Tees on Horizontal Drain Runs
description: Using a standard sanitary tee to join horizontal waste lines is a common installation mistake that frequently causes drain blockages. Sanitary tees feature a short-radius sweep designed specifically for transitioning horizontal flow into a vertical drop. When installed in a horizontal-to-horizontal orientation, wastewater entering the junction lacks a gradual direction change. This causes solid waste to hit the back wall of the pipe and accumulate, leading to persistent clogs and potential back-flow. To maintain proper directional flow and prevent solids from settling, horizontal drain pipe intersections must always use a combination wye fitting or a standard wye with a 45-degree street elbow.
